title: "Brexpiprazole (Rexulti™) Safety and Efficacy Among Filipino Patients (RAISE) - A Post Marketing Surveillance Program"
brief_summary: The objective of this post marketing surveillance is to further gather local data on the safety and efficacy of Brexpiprazole (RexultiTM) Film-coated Tablet in the treatment of schizophrenia and adjunctive therapy of Major Depressive Disorder.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* A total of 300 subjects will be included in the trial
* Adults (18 years old and above)
* Male and Female

Exclusion Criteria:

* N/A
study_population: A total of 300 patients in the Philippines diagnosed with Schizophrenia and Major Depressive Disorder
